facts.claim: Relay's project-root DESIGN.md is the authoritative visual and material contract for this implementation.
The approved Relay palette uses black and near-black surfaces, light text, lime activity, teal and gold data accents, and red failure feedback.

facts.claim: Relay surfaces use square corners, one-pixel divisions, compact density, and no gradients, blur, glass, panel shadows, or ornamental glow.
The UI is implemented with Lit light-DOM components, native SVG paths, and CSS rather than a second application state engine.
The overview renders real connection, cached, empty, denied, worker, board, device, and committed-record state from the Relay store and broker boundaries.
